name: captions-default
description: Easy Edits default caption style, taken from the stock porter-clipper-short project (Herk Edit Kit): Montserrat 900 100px white uppercase (raised from the stock 84px to read on a phone; one size for the whole video), 1-2 word spring pops, subtle shadow, inside the 9:16 safe zone, never over graphics or the face.
rules: Caption centre stays inside safeZone (clear of platform UI top and bottom).
face/punch layouts: below the chin, on the jacket (never over the face).
split layout: on the seam between graphic panel and speaker (never over the graphic).
One settled size for every caption in every layout: font.size, pop settles at scale 1, no per-layout or per-caption scaling.
